parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the destination resource group. You can view resource group IDs in the Resource Management console.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource to be moved. The value must match the specified ResourceType.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. The value is case-sensitive and must exactly match one of the valid values.

parameters.name: Service
parameters.description: The cloud service identifier. Fixed as APIG. You generally do not need to specify this parameter.
